question: Select the top 50 most variable metabolites (by variance across samples, computed on raw values) and perform a one-sided (alternative='greater') Fisher's exact test to identify enriched metabolic pathways. Use the SUPER_PATHWAY column in the metabolomics metadata and report one row per pathway.

expected_output.guidelines: Per-pathway rows must match the reference in Overlap and Pathway_Size (exact integers), and Odds_Ratio and P_Value within 1% relative absolute error; row order and column order may differ.
